citations.claim: light body starts inside arena moving left at 15 m/s
one step before violation light body already moving right at ~133.5 m/s after being sandwiched between heavy body and right wall
first violating step: light body centre x=19.739 exceeds arena bound by 0.239 beyond 0.15 tolerance, moving outward

explanation: 100:1 mass-ratio head-on collision (20kg at +60 vs 0.2kg at -15) crushes the light body against the right boundary wall. Impulse plus positional correction injects huge velocity (~133 m/s) into the light body; it rebounds into the wall region and is then ejected outside the arena, exceeding the 0.15 in_arena tolerance at step 9. Deep overlap gap -0.76 at violation shows contact solver failed to separate sandwich collision stably.
vision_note: The small red body stays deeply overlapped with the side of the large blue body as the pair drifts toward the right arena edge from steps 6 to 8. At step 9 the pair reaches the boundary with the red body pinched between the blue body and the right wall and sticking outside the arena.
